items.html: *At the beginning of my studies with my teacher, of blessed memory, he would conceal and cover and clothe the matters, because I did not yet know the beginning of the matters in the order I have explained in the previous gates. Therefore, when he began to explain to me then the matter of Atik Yomin, he explained to me one discourse, and we shall write it here. And I could not connect it with what I have written until now; nevertheless I wish to write it, and perhaps the examiner will be able to connect it with the above, for the words appear to contradict the above. And this is its matter. It is known that at first there were ten Nekudim, and the first three were not broken, and the vessels and the lights remained; but the seven lower Nekudot were broken, and the vessels descended to Beria, while the lights remained in their place in the world of Atzilut, with no garment at all. And know that from the three first Nekudot, both in the discernment of the lights and in the discernment of the vessels, the Partzuf of Atik Yomin alone was made, and no other force is mingled in them. However, in the seven lower Nekudot there are many forces mingled in them; for there is an upper discernment in each of the seven Nekudot, which is of the discernment of Atik; and there is a second discernment likewise in each of the seven, which is of AA; and there is a discernment of AVI; and there is a lower discernment in them, which is of ZON.
